text:
Two corn cob pieces (each about 4-5 cm long) and a small spinach salad with a couple of cherry tomatoes and shredded carrot.

The plate is about 22-26 cm wide. Each corn piece is about 5 cm across and 3-4 cm long, so roughly 60-70 g each. Together that is about 130 g, or around 110 kcal.

The salad has about 25 g of spinach, 2 cherry tomatoes at about 30 g, and a little carrot, so about 60 g and 20 kcal. There is no visible dressing.

The total is about 190 g and about 130 kcal.
